item.title: IRGC Navy says two 'violating' oil tankers hit naval mine in Hormuz Strait
item.description:
IRGC Navy says two 'violating' oil tankers hit naval mine in Hormuz Strait

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy said that two "offending" oil tankers on the southern and eastern coasts of the Strait of Hormuz suffered explosions. 

"These tankers, believing they were secretly trying to pass through the fake Strait of Hormuz route, were prevented from passing by naval mines, causing a massive explosion and fire," it said in a statement. 

"We warn all crews of ships with navigation and positioning systems turned off, be careful not to let the lies of American officials lead you to the explosion and fire of naval mines," the IRGC added.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it downed four drones over kingdom's Eastern Province

Saudi-led coalition says it downed four drones over kingdom's Eastern Province

The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four drones in Ras Tanura, located in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province.

The coalition's spokesperson Turki al-Maliki indicated that a number of fragments had fallen as a result of the interception, with no casualties reported in the initial assessment.

item.title: The Nvidia case is just the latest episode of Trump disregarding intelligence
item.description:
Trump’s reaction to sensitive information that contradicts his worldview mirrors his conduct towards war with Iran

Donald Trump’s unwillingness to heed warnings of suspected Chinese penetration of the tech giant Nvidia follows a pattern of the US president ignoring sensitive intelligence that contradicts his world view.

Trump disregarded repeated information that the company’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, was having an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy that threatened to undermine Washington’s geo-strategically vital goal of pipping China for global supremacy in the artificial intelligence race.
